blocks.text: Cebu Institute of Technology – University (CIT-U) celebrated three of its Electrical Engineering (EE) graduates who landed in the national Top 6 of the September 2026 Registered Electrical Engineer Licensure Examination (REELE) during a press conference at the university’s College Library on September 16, 2026. Charles Anthony Saceda Santillan ranked Top 1 with a 94.25% rating, while Kienth Vincent Espere Oracion placed Top 3 with 93.55% and Niño Louie Pala Verame ranked Top 6 with 93.05%. Their results add to CIT-U’s continuing record of producing board-exam achievers while highlighting the academic support, scholarships, peer collaboration and culture of excellence that shaped […]...
